CHAPTER 06
Sales events

Description: In 2024, the online shopping event CyberDay took place in Chile from June 3 to June 5. Over those three days, the event generated approximately 470 billion Chilean pesos in sales revenue. That is an increase of nearly 35 billion compared to the revenue
